newsitem.title: NIGERIA: More than 50 killed in Nigerian road accident.
newsitem.headline: More than 50 killed in Nigerian road accident.

text.p: More than 50 people, including school children, were killed when an articulated truck hurtled into a car park in eastern Nigeria, local newspapers reported on Tuesday.
The semi-official Daily Times said the brakes failed on the cement-loaded truck and it ran downhill into the parking lot, wrecking vehicles and killing and maiming many people on its way.
The victims were traders, school children and other travellers waiting for vehicles to various destinations in Onitsha, Anambra state.
